title: Who Are You When Nobody's Watching You
medium: Mixed media on MDF, Epoxy & Resin
meta: Medium: Mixed media on MDF (plywood), Epoxy & Resin Coated
Framing: Handcrafted wooden frame, delivered ready to hang
statement: This work asks a direct, intimate question – one that lingers. With a quiet grid beneath handwritten typography, it becomes a visual mirror for identity, inviting viewers to confront who they are without an audience, without performance, without filter.
